title: Mechanism of Eucalyptus oil in alleviating UUO-induced renal fibrosis revealed by transcriptomics and metabolomics.
authors: Li, Na; Qi, Huili; Li, Jiacun; Cheng, Xiaoling; Li, Xin; Zhang, Ke; Aimaier, Shabaaiti; Wang, Yanli; Li, Jialu; Guo, Yaping; Yao, Dahong; Wang, Hangyu; Wang, Jinhui
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桉树油缓解肾纤维化的转录组与代谢组机制，涉及信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Renal fibrosis (RF), a major contributor to the progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD), is an important therapeutic target. Eucalyptus oil (EO), a volatile extract derived from traditional Chinese herbal medicine with known anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, has shown potential in CKD treatment. However, its efficacy and mechanisms in preventing kidney injury induced by unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO) remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate the protective effects of EO against renal injury in UUO rats and to investigate its underlying mechanisms of action. METHODS: A UUO-induced rat model of RF was established to assess the antifibrotic effects of EO. Integrated multi-omics approaches, including genomic and metabolomic analyses, along with molecular docking and experimental validation using Western blot and qPCR, were employed to systematically elucidate the molecular mechanisms and pharmacodynamic basis of EO in alleviating RF. RESULTS: EO significantly reduced RF in the UUO model by concurrently inhibiting the transforming growth factor-beta 1 (TGF-beta1)/Smad3 signaling pathway and the tryptophan metabolism-aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) axis. Specifically, EO suppressed Smad3 phosphorylation, fibroblast activation, and extracellular matrix (ECM) accumulation. It also inhibited AhR nuclear translocation and reduced the expression of cytochrome P450 1A1 (Cyp1A1), cytochrome P450 1B1 (Cyp1B1), and aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator (ARNT). These molecular effects were associated with improvements in renal function indicators, including reductions in serum creatinine (SCR), blood urea nitrogen (BUN), and kidney injury molecule-1 (KIM-1). EO also mitigated histological damage and decreased oxidative stress markers-malondialdehyde (MDA), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and glutathione (GSH)-as well as inflammatory mediators-monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1), interleukin-1 beta (IL-1beta), and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha). These findings highlight the multitarget antifibrotic potential of EO. CONCLUSION: EO suppresses renal fibrosis by inhibiting both the TGF-beta1/Smad3 signaling pathway and the tryptophan metabolism-AhR pathway, thereby reducing abnormal ECM accumulation.
abstract_zh: 背景：肾纤维化（RF）是慢性肾脏病（CKD）进展的主要促进因素，是一个重要的治疗靶点。桉叶油（EO）是一种源自传统中草药的挥发性提取物，具有已知的抗炎和抗氧化特性，在CKD治疗中显示出潜力。然而，其在单侧输尿管梗阻（UUO）诱导的肾损伤中的疗效和机制仍不清楚。目的：本研究旨在评估EO对UUO大鼠肾损伤的保护作用，并探讨其潜在的作用机制。方法：建立UUO诱导的RF大鼠模型，以评估EO的抗纤维化效果。采用整合多组学方法，包括基因组学和代谢组学分析，结合分子对接以及Western blot和qPCR实验验证，系统阐明EO缓解RF的分子机制和药效基础。结果：EO通过同时抑制转化生长因子-β1（TGF-beta1）/Smad3信号通路和色氨酸代谢-芳香烃受体（AhR）轴，显著减轻了UUO模型中的RF。具体而言，EO抑制了Smad3磷酸化、成纤维细胞活化和细胞外基质（ECM）积累。它还抑制了AhR核转位，并降低了细胞色素P450 1A1（Cyp1A1）、细胞色素P450 1B1（Cyp1B1）和芳香烃受体核转位蛋白（ARNT）的表达。这些分子效应与肾功能指标的改善相关，包括血清肌酐（SCR）、血尿素氮（BUN）和肾损伤分子-1（KIM-1）的降低。EO还减轻了组织学损伤，并降低了氧化应激标志物——丙二醛（MDA）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和谷胱甘肽（GSH）——以及炎症介质——单核细胞趋化蛋白-1（MCP-1）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1beta）和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）。这些发现突显了EO的多靶点抗纤维化潜力。结论：EO通过抑制TGF-beta1/Smad3信号通路和色氨酸代谢-AhR通路，从而减少异常ECM积累，抑制肾纤维化。
